title: Intelligent household electrical appliance synchronization test method and device based on voice interaction
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of household appliance testing, and particularly relates to an intelligent household appliance synchronous testing method and device based on voice interaction. The invention aims to solve the problems of long time consumption and low test efficiency in the existing test process. According to the intelligent household electrical appliance synchronization test method and device based on voice interaction, the preset first voice test task and the preset second voice test task are obtained, and the voice test tasks comprise the voice control function test and the verification function test of the intelligent household electrical appliance; and executing a voice control function test in the first voice test task, and after receiving a signal indicating that the voice control function test is completed, controlling a verification function test in the first voice test task to be synchronously executed with the second voice test task. According to the method, the first voice test task and the second voice test task are controlled to be tested synchronously, so that the test process time is shortened, and the test efficiency is improved.

title: Gesture recognition method and system for rehabilitation of aphasia patient
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of action recognition, in particular to a gesture recognition method and system for rehabilitation of aphasia patients. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, extracting key points in each action frame image; acquiring gesture change vectors of the action frame images according to the difference between the spatial distribution of the key points corresponding to each action frame image and the adjacent action frame images in the time sequence; dividing the action frame image sequence to obtain all local frame image sequences of the action frame image sequence; obtaining a distance metric value of every two action frame image sequences according to a difference condition of gesture change vectors of the local frame image sequences corresponding to every two action frame image sequences; and performing action recognition on the action frame image sequence to be processed according to the distance metric value between the action frame image sequence to be processed and the action category. According to the method, the gesture recognition features are deeply analyzed, so that the accuracy and efficiency of gesture recognition of the aphasia patient are guaranteed, and the gesture recognition effect is improved.

title: Live broadcast follow-up practice video detection method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to artificial intelligence, and provides a live broadcast follow-up practice video detection method and device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a live broadcast motion video and a follow-up training video, calculating a playing frequency according to a first video duration of the live broadcast motion video and a second video duration of the follow-up training video, extracting a standard video sequence based on the playing frequency, and extracting a follow-up training action sequence; detecting a standard key point of each standard video frame and a user key point of each follow-up training frame, identifying a standard action angle of each standard video frame based on the standard key points, and identifying a follow-up training action angle of each follow-up training frame based on the user key points; and according to the standard action angle and the follow-up action angle, the follow-up training rating can be accurately generated. In addition, the invention also relates to a block chain technology, and the follow-up rating can be stored in a block chain.

title: DETERMINING A TARGET POLICY FOR MANAGING AN ENVIRONMENT
abstract: A computer implemented method (100) is disclosed for determining a target policy for managing an environment that is operable to perform a task. The method comprises obtaining a training dataset comprising records of task performance by the environment during a period of management according to a reference policy (110), and repeating, at a plurality of time steps until a stopping condition is satisfied, the steps of selecting a record of task performance from the training data set (130), using the selected record to update an initiated estimate of a linear function mapping an observed environment context and selected action to a predicted value of reward (140), and checking whether the stopping condition has been satisfied (150). The method further comprises outputting as the target policy a function operable to select for execution in the environment an action which, for a given context, is mapped by the estimate of the linear function at the time the stopping condition is satisfied to the maximum predicted value of reward (170).

title: FLUID CIRCULATED LINEAR MOTOR FOR ROBOTIC SYSTEMS
abstract: A linear motor comprised of a plurality of primary coils arranged and spaced sequentially. A fluid intake manifold and a fluid exhaust manifold with at least one conduit in fluid communication between the intake and exhaust manifolds, such that the fluid intake manifold, fluid exhaust manifold and conduit are associated with the primary coils to control the temperature of the motor. A robotically controlled linear motor apparatus for manipulating physical arms in one or more dimensions, with at least one linear motor comprised of primary coils sequentially and spacially arranged and a secondary coil positioned magnetically adjacent to the primary coils. A fluid circulating manifold as described above. A commutator for selectively energizing the primary and secondary coils to create a magnetic imbalance therebetween so that the secondary coil is urged in a direction opposite to that of the flux imbalance. A first arm is fixed to one the secondary coils and a second arm is fixed to the primary coils so that when a secondary coil moves, the first arm moves in reference to the second physical arm. A control for manipulating the first physical arm in one or more dimensions by selectively energizing the commutator to energize the linear motor causing the secondary coil and attached physical arm to move in relation thereto.

title: Elastic type sole assembly in wearable robot absorbing impact and detecting ground reaction force
abstract: The present invention relates to an elastic type sole assembly of a wearable robot absorbing an impact transmitted from a ground surface to a wearer or a wearable robot, and measuring a ground reaction force and a position of a point of application of the ground reaction force. According to the present invention, one or more elastic type sole assemblies of a wearable robot absorbing an impact and measuring a ground reaction force are installed between a sole of the wearer and a foot portion of the wearable robot (R); absorbs the impact generated between the sole of the wearer on the foot portion of the wearable robot (R) and between the foot portion of the wearable robot (R) and the ground surface when the foot portion of the wearable robot (R) comes in contact with the ground surface; and comprises sole units (10, 20) deformed to measure a reaction force of the ground surface.

title: Generation method and device of cartoon face image and computer storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a generation method and device of a cartoon face image and a computer storage medium. In the method, a to-be-processed face image is acquired; face feature information is recognized from the to-be-processed face image, and includes five-sense-organ features information; cartoon materials corresponding to all face feature parts in the to-be-processed face image are respectively acquired according to the face feature information to obtain cartoon face materials, and the cartoon face materials include cartoon five-sense-organ materials and other cartoon materials other than the cartoon five-sense-organ materials; adjustment parameters are utilized to respectively adjust each of the cartoon five-sense-organ materials; and the other cartoon materials and the adjusted cartoon five-sense-organ materials are combined to generate the cartoon face image. Through the above manner, operability of the cartoon face image and similarity with the to-be-processed face image can be improved.

title: Intelligent sucker capable of counting
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of suction cups, and discloses a countable intelligent suction cup which comprises a first shell and a second shell, the first shell and the second shell are in sealed connection through a screw rod, and the first shell and the second shell form a mounting cavity; a charging port is formed in one side of the first shell, a charging module is arranged in the mounting cavity, a battery is arranged in the mounting cavity, a control module is arranged on one side of the battery, a technical screen is arranged on one side of the first shell in a penetrating mode, a display panel is arranged in the mounting cavity, and the display panel is attached to a counting screen. And adsorption cavities are formed in the bottoms of the first shell and the second shell. The suction and release actions of the suction cup are accurately captured in real time through the pressure sensor, the counting error can be controlled within an extremely small range in cooperation with the high-performance counter, and compared with a traditional manual recording mode, the accuracy during use is improved.

title: Double-foot wheel-leg robot motion control system based on servo motors
abstract: The invention discloses a double-foot wheel-leg robot motion control system based on servo motors. The system comprises a power supply module used for supplying power to the system; the IMU module is used for collecting the pitch angle course angle, the pitch angle speed and the course angle speed of the robot; the robot adopts a two-foot roller robot and is provided with four servo motors, two hip joint motors are responsible for adjusting the leg length and jumping of the robot, and the other two ankle joint motors are responsible for balancing, advancing and steering of the robot; the main control unit is used for controlling rotation of the four servo motors, and the linear driving torque and the steering torque of the robot are obtained through the hip joint motor torque by means of the stress balance relation of the left wheel and the body of the robot. The LQR control method is adopted to calculate a state feedback matrix required by control output of the STM32 main control unit, and application control of the biped wheel-legged robot can be achieved.

abstract: The present invention relates to an industrial robot comprising: a platform (16) arranged for carrying the object, a first arm (7) arranged for influencing the platform in a first movement and comprising a first actuator having a first path (1) and a first carriage (4) linearly movable along the first path, a second arm (8) arranged for influencing the platform in a second movement, comprising a second actuator having a second path (2) and a second carriage (5) linearly movable along the first path, a third arm arranged for influencing the platform in a third movement, and a control unit controlling the movements of the platform. title: Feedback for unrecognized speech
abstract: A feedback process for providing feedback for unrecognized speech includes a speech input process for receiving a speech command as spoken by a user. An unrecognized speech comparison process, responsive to the speech input process, compares the user's speech command to a plurality of recognized speech commands available in a speech library to determine if the user's speech command is unrecognized speech, as opposed to non-speech.

title: Vehicle-mounted system
abstract: Provided is an in-vehicle system capable of suppressing the failure of emotion-based vehicle control. This in-vehicle system is provided with: a control device; an in-vehicle sensor that detects whether or not a priority subject is present among occupants present in the vehicle; and a storage device that stores a learned model for emotion estimation, the control device being configured to: determine, on the basis of a detection result of the in-vehicle sensor, whether or not a prioritized person is present among occupants present in the vehicle; when it is determined that the priority subject exists, information relating to the priority subject is acquired; a sentiment estimation unit that estimates the sentiment of the priority subject on the basis of the acquired information using the learned model; furthermore, vehicle control is performed on the basis of the result obtained by estimating the emotion of the priority subject.

title: SUBSTRATE TREATING APPARATUS
abstract: PURPOSE: A substrate processing apparatus is provided to stably load a substrate on a support unit by reducing impact between the substrate and the support unit. CONSTITUTION: An index module(200) transfers a substrate between a cassette loaded on a holder(120) of a load port and a first buffer module(300) and includes a frame(210), an index robot(220), and a guide rail(230). A coating and developing module(400) coats the substrate with a photoresist before an exposure process and develops the substrate after the exposure process. A second buffer module(500) cools the substrate or performs an edge exposure process. A processing module(600) coats a protection layer to protect a photoresist film before and after the exposure process.

title: Hotel robot fault diagnosis method and device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, and discloses a hotel robot fault diagnosis method and device, a medium and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: responding to a target fault item appearing in a hotel robot, and determining a candidate diagnosis item list related to the target fault item; inquiring the actual state value of the hotel robot in each candidate diagnosis item, and diagnosing an abnormal diagnosis item in the candidate diagnosis item list based on the actual state value; based on each abnormal diagnosis item, correspondingly determining a fault reason causing the hotel robot to have a target fault item, and obtaining a fault reason list; obtaining a first diagnosis success rate of the target fault item in history, and determining a first accuracy rate of the fault cause list based on the first diagnosis success rate; and outputting the fault cause list and the first accuracy rate as a first diagnosis result. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the accuracy of the diagnosis result can be output to help developers to optimize the diagnosis project.

title: Control system for intelligent voice remote control pen
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of signal channel switching, in particular to a control system for an intelligent voice remote control pen based on human-computer interaction of an automatic test and diagnosis system of electronic equipment and rapid signal channel switching. The system comprises a voice recognition module, a data transmission module, a microcontroller working module, a Bluetooth module, a data processing module and a channel switching module. The voice recognition module is connected with the microcontroller working module through the data transmission module; the microcontroller working module is connected with the data processing module through the Bluetooth module; and the data processing module is connected with the channel switching module. In the working process, the voice recognition accuracy is high, and power consumption is low. The channel switching speed is effectively improved, and the operation process is simplified. And the use convenience and practicability of the remote control pen are enhanced.

title: RELAY DRONE CONTROL SYSTEM AND RELAY DRONE CONTROL METHOD USING THE SAME
abstract: As an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a relay drone controlling system comprising: a main drone; a controlling device which controls the main drone by communicating with the main drone; and a relay drone which relays communication between the main drone and the controlling device. The controlling device includes a relay drone coordinate determining unit which estimates at least one relay drone coordinate for relaying the communication between the main drone and the controlling device by setting each signal output performance data of the main drone, the relay drone, and the controlling device, each antenna beam pattern data of the main drone, the relay drone, and the controlling device, a coordinate of the controlling device, a movement target coordinate of the main drone, and 3D space information data between the main drone and the controlling device as an input of an artificial neural network model. The present invention can prevent degradation of a communication speed of drone controlling data.

title: Intelligent optimization method and system for multi-area feeding decision of cattle and sheep
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent optimization method for multi-area feeding decision of cattle and sheep. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining individual parameters and environmental parameters of cattle and sheep; according to the individual parameters and the environmental parameters, an initial feeding strategy is constructed through a decision tree algorithm; dynamic physiological parameters and environmental parameters of cattle and sheep are obtained, the initial feeding strategy is dynamically optimized according to an incremental learning method, the dynamic physiological parameters and the environmental parameters, and a global optimal feeding strategy is obtained according to a Q-learning algorithm; and judging whether the global optimal feeding strategy meets a preset constraint condition or not, and when the constraint condition is met, converting the global optimal feeding strategy into an execution plan and monitoring execution. Individual and precise intelligent feeding of cattle and sheep is achieved, the feeding strategy can be adjusted in time according to the animal physiological state and the environment change, and the feeding efficiency and economic benefits are effectively improved.

title: Current sudden change risk prediction method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a current abrupt change risk prediction method based on reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting a current signal sequence of monitored electrical equipment and executing feature extraction operation; s2, inputting the current state vector into an improved dual depth Q network, executing a forward reasoning operation, and generating an action value prediction result in a current state; s3, executing an action selection operation by adopting an epsilon-greedy strategy to generate a selected action; s4, constructing a reward function, and generating a corresponding reward value; s5, forming an experience tetrad; s6, calculating a target action value by using the target Q network, updating parameters of the main Q network, and periodically synchronizing the parameters of the main Q network to the target Q network; and S7, after training optimization is completed, deploying the improved dual deep Q network into the current monitoring system, and outputting a current mutation risk prediction result. According to the invention, the improved dual deep Q network is adopted, and real-time intelligent prediction and early warning of the current sudden change risk are realized.

title: IMAGE-PROCESSING DEVICE, IMAGE-PROCESSING METHOD, AND IMAGE-PROCESSING PROGRAM
abstract: An image processing system includes an imaging device that captures an image of a measurement object to obtain a captured image, an arrangement detection unit that detects an arrangement state of the measurement object and determines a tilt angle of the measurement object relative to the imaging device, a storage unit that stores a template image, a skew correction unit that corrects the captured image based on the tilt angle determined by the arrangement detection unit to generate a skew-corrected image, a scale correction unit that calculates an amount of scale deviation between the skew-corrected image and the template image and corrects the skew-corrected image based on the calculated amount of scale deviation to generate a scale-corrected image, and a position search unit that performs template matching using the template image on the scale-corrected image to determine a position corresponding to the template image in the captured image.
abstract_en: An image processing system includes an imaging device that captures an image of a measurement object to obtain a captured image, an arrangement detection unit that detects an arrangement state of the measurement object and determines a tilt angle of the measurement object relative to the imaging device, a storage unit that stores a template image, a skew correction unit that corrects the captured image based on the tilt angle determined by the arrangement detection unit to generate a skew-corrected image, a scale correction unit that calculates an amount of scale deviation between the skew-corrected image and the template image and corrects the skew-corrected image based on the calculated amount of scale deviation to generate a scale-corrected image, and a position search unit that performs template matching using the template image on the scale-corrected image to determine a position corresponding to the template image in the captured image.

title: Fast and robust initialization method for feature-based monocular visual SLAM using inertial odometry assistance
abstract: A method and system for capturing, by a camera a sequence of frames at respective locations within a portion of an environment; capturing, by an inertial measurement unit, a sequence of inertial odometry data corresponding to the sequence of frames at the respective locations; storing in a queue a data record includes information extracted from processing the respective frame and information from the inertial measurement unit; in accordance with a determination that the sequence of inertial odometry data satisfies a first criterion: calculating a first relative pose between the first frame and the second frame; and in accordance with a determination that a difference between the first relative pose and the information extracted from processing the respective frame satisfy a first threshold: generating an initial map of the portion of the environment based on the first data record and the second data record.

title: Intelligent face recognition attendance checking and temperature measuring all-in-one machine
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of attendance checking and temperature measuring all-in-one machines. The invention further discloses an intelligent face recognition attendance checking and temperature measuring all-in-one machine. The intelligent face recognition attendance checking and temperature measuring all-in-one machine comprises a machine body, a display screen, a detection probe, an infrared temperature probe and a fingerprint groove; the display screen is arranged on the front side wall of the machine body; the detection probe and the infrared temperature probe are botharranged above the display screen; the fingerprint groove is formed in the bottom of the display screen; a fixing frame is fixedly arranged in the middle of the outer wall of the machine body, firstscrews are vertically and rotationally arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper surface of the fixing frame through rolling bearings, a protective cover is arranged at the top of themachine body, inner threaded sleeves are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the protective cover, and the upper ends of the two first screws are in threaded connection with the inner walls of the two inner threaded sleeves. The intelligent face recognition attendance checking and temperature measuring all-in-one machine is convenient to move and use, the display screen can beprotected when the all-in-one machine is not used, and the use safety is guaranteed.

title: Scheduling method, device and equipment based on inter-city online car-hailing supply and demand length sequence prediction and medium
abstract: The invention provides a scheduling method, device and equipment based on inter-city online-hailed car supply and demand length sequence prediction and a medium, and relates to the technical field of inter-city online-hailed car scheduling. The scheduling method comprises steps S1 to S4. S1, obtaining the current order demand quantity and the current transport capacity supply quantity of the double cities; and S2, respectively inputting the order demand quantity and the transport capacity supply quantity into an order demand long sequence prediction model and a transport capacity supply long sequence prediction model constructed based on an improved I nformer model, and obtaining predicted future order demand quantity and future transport capacity supply quantity. And S3, calculating a supply-demand ratio function and an unbalance coefficient at each moment based on the current order demand, the current transport capacity supply, the future order demand and the future transport capacity supply. And S4, inputting the supply-demand ratio function and the imbalance coefficient at each moment into a multi-agent reinforcement learning inter-city unilateral supply-demand imbalance scheduling model constructed based on a multi-agent depth deterministic policy algorithm MADDPG for scheduling, and obtaining a recommended scheduling action.

title: OBJECT STATE RECOGNITION METHOD AND APPARATUS, COMPUTER DEVICE, AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: The present application relates to an object state recognition method and apparatus, a computer device, a storage medium, and a computer program product. The method comprises: acquiring a target video (step S202); acquiring a background frame corresponding to the target video, and determining, from the target video, a target frame corresponding to a target action of a target object (step S204); performing image segmentation on the background frame and the target frame to obtain object regions respectively corresponding to objects in the background frame and a target region corresponding to the target object in the target frame (step S206); generating interaction information groups on the basis of position information of the target region and the object regions, the objects corresponding to the object regions, and the target action, so as to obtain an interaction information group between the target object and each object (step S208); and on the basis of each interaction information group, determining a target object state of the target object corresponding to the target frame (step S210).

title: Driving digital human expression generation method
abstract: The invention provides a driving digital human expression generation method, and relates to the technical field of digital human generation, and the generation method comprises the steps: obtaining a driving video and a driven video; the driving video is an expression providing object of the driven video; inputting the driving video into a target three-dimensional face reconstruction model to obtain a target face coefficient feature; inputting the target facial coefficient feature and the driven video into a target expression generation model to obtain a driven image with a target expression; performing video coding based on the driven image to obtain a target video; the target video is a video combining the face information of the driven video and the target expression of the driving video. Through the generation method, the problem that the driving digital human expression generated based on the prior art is too stiff is solved.

title: System and method for combining phonetic and automatic speech recognition search
abstract: A text search query including one or more words may be received. An ASR index created for an audio recording may be searched over using the query to produce ASR search results including words, each word associated with a confidence score. For each of the words in the ASR search results associated with a confidence score below a threshold (and in some cases having one or more preceding words in the ASR index and one or more subsequent words in the ASR index), a phonetic representation of the audio recording may be searched for the word having the confidence score below the threshold, where it occurs in the audio recording, possibly after the one or more preceding words and in the audio recording before the one or more subsequent words, to produce phonetic search results. Search results may be returned include ASR and phonetic results.

title: User behavior prediction method and system for virtual reality technology
abstract: The invention discloses a user behavior prediction method and system for a virtual reality technology, and relates to the technical field of computer vision. The invention discloses a user behavior prediction system for a virtual reality technology. The user behavior prediction system comprises a prediction model construction module, a user behavior prediction module and a user behavior prediction feedback module. By constructing the user behavior prediction initial model based on the big data user dynamic video, the general characteristics and modes of the user behaviors can be effectively captured, the user behavior prediction initial model is further optimized through the behavior data of the target user, the model can be closer to the behavior characteristics of the target user, and the user behavior prediction accuracy is improved. Therefore, the accuracy of user behavior prediction is improved; by collecting the dynamic video of the target user in the preset virtual reality scene and extracting the user behavior vector, the constructed target user behavior prediction model can train and predict the specific behavior mode of the individual user, so that the personalized service is realized.

title: Face feature adding method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention provides (a) face feature adding method, device and equipment. The face feature adding method comprises that an image to be stacked is generated on the basis of a given face image and features to be added to the given face image; and the image to be stacked is stacked on the given face image to generated a composite face image. The method further comprises that a face determining deep convolutional network is used to generate first and second face satisfaction-degree scores on the basis of the composite face image and a real image with the features to be added; an L1 norm of the image to be stacked is calculated, and coefficients of networks are updated according to the first and second face satisfaction-degree scores and the L1 norm.

title: Method and system for power savings in voice control of a computing device
abstract: Methods and systems for controlling a portable computing device (“PCD”) are disclosed. In an example method, an always on processor (AoP) of a voice recognition module of the PCD receives a voice command. The AoP determines, without decoding the received voice command, that the received voice command corresponds to a previously determined keyword. The AoP retrieves context data associated with the previously determined keyword. The AoP acts on the voice command using the context data, including in some embodiments automatically triggering a fast dormancy of a communications channel.

title: Powered exoskeleton wrist component
abstract: An exoskeleton component includes a wrist base structure, wrist intermediate structure, and end effector support structure. A first driveline output is disposed about a first axis. The first driveline output is coupled to the wrist intermediate structure for common rotation relative to the wrist base structure. A first motor drives the first driveline output to rotate. A second driveline output is disposed about a second axis that is transverse the first axis. The second driveline output is coupled to the end effector support structure for common rotation relative to the wrist intermediate structure. A second motor drives the second driveline output to rotate. An input device is coupled to the wrist base structure. A controller is configured to receive input signals from the input device and to control the first motor and the second motor in response to the input signals.

title: Sudden change trajectory tracking control method based on data driving and learning model predictive control
abstract: The invention relates to a sudden change trajectory tracking control method based on data driving and learning model predictive control, and belongs to the field of trajectory tracking control. In order to solve the problem that an existing trajectory tracking method cannot track a sudden change trajectory exceeding the tracking capability of an unmanned system, a learning model prediction control algorithm is firstly established, and an optimal target trajectory is re-planned by weighing the tracking capability of the unmanned system and the deviation degree of the sudden change trajectory. Afterwards, for the problems that a traditional planning method is poor in optimization capability and learning model predictive control calculation complexity is high, a long short-term memory network (LSTM) is designed to learn a deep mapping relation between an optimal target trajectory and an auxiliary trajectory calculated by a traditional planning algorithm, and a robust model predictive control algorithm is combined, so that the optimal target trajectory is obtained. And the unmanned system is controlled in real time to track the target track with the abrupt change point.

title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE, METHOD, AND NON-TRANSITORY COMPUTER-READABLE RECORDING MEDIUM FOR IDENTIFYING LOCATION OF EXTERNAL DEVICE
abstract: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device may transmit, through a communication circuit, a command to start cleaning to a cleaning robot for sucking foreign substances while moving around a cleaning area on the basis of a map of the cleaning area. The electronic device may transmit, to at least one external electronic device through the communication circuit, a command to transmit sound data for a sound signal measured by the at least one external electronic device. The electronic device may identify the location of the at least one external electronic device on the map on the basis of the sound data and location information of the cleaning robot during the cleaning.

title: ROBOT-CONVEYOR CALIBRATION METHOD, ROBOT SYSTEM AND CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract: Method for calibrating a robot coordinate system (Xbase, Xmi, Xtool) of a robot (12) with a conveyor coordinate system (Xcon) of a movable conveyor member (18), the method comprising providing a sensor (24) configured to detect positions of the robot (12) in a non-contact manner; detecting a position of the robot (12) when the conveyor member (18) is positioned at a first operating position; detecting a position of the robot (12) and/or of the conveyor member (18) by the sensor (24) in the sensor coordinate system (Xsen) when the conveyor member (18) is positioned at a second operating position different from the first operating position; and determining a relationship between the robot coordinate system (Xbase, Xmi, Xtool) and the conveyor coordinate system (Xcon) based on at least one detected position of the robot (12) in the sensor coordinate system (Xsen). A robot system (10) and a control system (16) are also provided.

title: MANAGEMENT APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR EXTERNAL WALL BASED ON IDENTIFYING WORK AREA
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and a method for managing and repairing the external wall of a building using the discrimination of a work area. A movable body for managing the external wall of the building stores work information to be performed on the work area and takes a photograph of a heat image for the building. And then, the movable body determines the work area according to the heat distribution of the heat image and performs corresponding works. Accordingly, the device for managing and repairing the external wall of a building can accurately grasp the work area to perform the work so that the management efficiency of the building can be increased. title: Unmanned autonomous operation restaurant food material automatic purchase and transportation system and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned autonomous restaurant food material automatic purchasing and transporting system and equipment, which comprises an automatic driving vehicle or an automatic walking robot and a driving system on the automatic driving vehicle and the automatic walking robot, and automatic road identification equipment is arranged in the automatic driving vehicle, the automatic walking robot and the driving system. The system has the functions of automatic elevator recognition, automatic map construction, automatic path planning, fixed line walking and automatic obstacle avoidance, and can achieve the results of reaching a plurality of set food material purchasing places, calling an authorized place to reach a destination and automatically returning when food materials are automatically purchased and transported. According to the invention, food material purchasing is realized through cooperation with other intelligent equipment, required food materials are automatically purchased in a shop, purchased articles can be automatically placed in a fixed placement position and then automatically leave, life is facilitated, an unmanned autonomous operation restaurant is developed in daily life and in the future, food material purchasing is realized, and unmanned purchasing and unmanned transportation are realized.

title: METHOD FOR CERTIFICATION USING FACE RECOGNITION AN SPEAKER VERIFICATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a certificating method converging face recognition and speaker recognition, capable of performing certification by recognizing a face and a voice and converging the face and the voice. One embodiment of the present invention comprises: a face feature point extracting step of detecting a face image from the entire image and extracting a face feature vector from the detected face image; a voice feature point extracting step of detecting a voice from an audio and extracting voice feature data from the detected voice; a face similarity calculating step of calculating a face similarity between a registered feature vector which is previously registered and the face feature vector extracted from the face image; a voice similarity calculating step of calculating a voice similarity between a registered feature data which is previously registered and the voice feature data extracted from the voice; and an identity certification step of performing an identity certification by applying the face similarity and the voice similarity to an artificial neural network model.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR CHARGING ROBOT
abstract: Disclosed are a method and a system for charging a robot. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for charging a robot includes: a step of monitoring the battery level of a first robot providing a service; a step of determining a charging robot for charging the first robot from multiple second robots based on that the battery level of the first robot is decreased to a first critical level; and a step of transmitting a command of moving to an aimed position to the determined charging robot. The step of determining the charging robot includes a step of determining the charging robot at least partially based on the battery levels of the second robots and the distance between the first robot and the second robots. According to embodiments of the present invention, the method for charging a robot can be performed by executing an artificial intelligence algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm in a 5G environment connected to the Internet of Things (IoT).

title: Data transmission system and method based on voice recognition trigger control
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of voice recognition, and particularly relates to a data transmission system and method based on voice recognition trigger control. title: Miniature lizard-imitating robot constructed based on carbon fiber paper folding technology
abstract: The invention discloses a miniature lizard-imitating robot constructed based on the carbon fiber paper folding technology. title: ROBOTIC CONTROL WITH REAL-TIME SWITCHING BETWEEN TRAJECTORIES
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for switching in real-time between different trajectories during custom real-time control. One of the methods include: obtaining a definition of a first trajectory for a robot and a definition of a second trajectory for the robot; executing a current action for controlling the robot to follow set points of the first trajectory at each control tick of the real-time robotic control system, including, at each control tick of the real-time robotic control system: obtaining current data representing a latest execution status of the current action; evaluating one or more switching criteria associated with the current action according to the current data; and whenever the one or more switching criteria are satisfied during the control tick, switching to executing another action for controlling the robot to follow the second trajectory within the control tick.

One of the methods include: obtaining a definition of a first trajectory for a robot and a definition of a second trajectory for the robot; executing a current action for controlling the robot to follow set points of the first trajectory at each control tick of the real-time robotic control system, including, at each control tick of the real-time robotic control system: obtaining current data representing a latest execution status of the current action; evaluating one or more switching criteria associated with the current action according to the current data; and whenever the one or more switching criteria are satisfied during the control tick, switching to executing another action for controlling the robot to follow the second trajectory within the control tick.

title: Low-altitude patrol method and device of unmanned aerial vehicle, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a low-altitude patrol method and device of an unmanned aerial vehicle, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of low-altitude patrol of the unmanned aerial vehicle. A digital display type live broadcast picture is defined according to a live broadcast picture of a target object and real-time dynamic multi-dimensional interaction of an original map to the target object; real-time dynamic multi-dimensional interaction of the live broadcast picture of the target object and the original map to the target object is realized, and multiple superposition of the corresponding live broadcast picture and multiple dynamic data of the target object is compatible based on the digital display type live broadcast picture. Furthermore, a corresponding decision result is defined based on the regional information set of the important region, the corresponding surrounding environment information and the corresponding decision model, so that multi-dimensional control of the regional information set of the important region, the corresponding surrounding environment information and the corresponding decision model is realized, and the accuracy of the decision result is ensured; and the scene of the unmanned aerial vehicle under low-altitude inspection is fully considered, so that the inspection efficiency of the target object is improved.

title: Model training method, relative relationship identification method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of face recognition, and discloses a model training method, a relative relationship recognition method, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The model training method comprises the following steps: constructing a family face feature extraction model for extracting family face features from family image samples; wherein the family image sample comprises a plurality of face images belonging to the same family, and the family face feature extraction model is provided with genetic type parameters used for fusing individual face features of the plurality of face images to form family face features. The genetic type parameter represents the dominant degree of a preset genetic type in a family to which the family image sample belongs; and constructing a loss function according to the distance between the family face feature of each family and the corresponding family label and the distance between the family face feature and the individual face feature of each face image in the corresponding family image sample, and training the family face feature extraction model.

abstract: A display device operating method, according to one embodiment of the present invention, comprises the steps of: receiving a voice command of a user; storing the voice command, if a function of the display device corresponding to the received voice command is not stored and the voice command is received at reference frequency or more; and if the voice command is received again, performing a function of the display device corresponding to the voice command received again.

title: Clamping adjusting mechanism of power transmission tower climbing robot and climbing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a clamping adjusting mechanism of a power transmission tower climbing robot and a climbing robot. Problems that climbing in the prior art is mainly targeted for tubular structures and cannot be applied to an angle iron tower are solved; and the clamping adjusting mechanism of the power transmission tower climbing robot has the beneficial effects that the structure is compact, the flexible degree is high and the clamping adjusting mechanism of the power transmission tower climbing robot can adapt to clamping of angle iron towers with different angles. The technical scheme is that the clamping adjusting mechanism of the power transmission tower climbing robot comprises manipulators and a mounting plate, wherein the manipulators comprise clamping claws; the clamping claws can be opened or closed to clamp one side of a tower; the manipulators can advance or retreat relative to the side part of the tower; the mounting plate is supported by a base bottom plate; the mounting plate is arranged at the end parts of the manipulators; and the manipulators realize rotating motion relative to the mounting plate through opening and closing parts so as to adjust the openingor closing of the manipulators relative to the mounting plate.

title: Method and device for identifying same-egg twins based on facial fusion features and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of biological identification, and discloses an identical twin identification method and device based on face fusion features and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a face image; respectively extracting a facial aging feature FAF and a facial asymmetry feature ASF from the face image, and extracting a facial local texture feature by using a rotation-invariant and noise-insensitive binary pattern BRINT; carrying out normalization processing on the extracted features, and constructing difference fusion features through feature serial splicing; carrying out feature embedding on the difference fusion features through a multi-layer perceptron; and a Triplet loss function is used to measure the similarity degree between individuals of the same-egg twins, and face identity identification of the same-egg twins is realized. The method has the beneficial effect that high-precision identification of the same-egg twins can be realized without excessive dependence on hardware equipment.

title: Engineering robot
abstract: The invention discloses an engineering robot. The engineering robot comprises a housing; a camera shooting and acquiring device and a walk monitoring device are arranged above the housing; a driving device is installed below the housing; a power supply, a data communicator and a positioning module are installed inside the housing; the camera shooting and acquiring device comprises a mounting bracket; the mounting bracket is equipped with high-definition cameras in four mutually perpendicular directions; a rotating mechanism is arranged between a mounting rod bracket and the housing; the walk monitoring device comprises surveillance cameras arranged around the housing; the driving device comprises a driving wheel, a spiral climbing device and a climbing crawler, wherein the driving wheel isarranged below the housing; the climbing crawler is arranged in front of the housing and is arranged obliquely; and the spiral climbing device is connected with the housing through a lifting mechanism. The engineering robot disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high automation degree, flexible movement and strong climbing function.

title: Mobile intelligent terminal theft prevention method based on on-off encryption verification
abstract: The invention relates to a mobile intelligent terminal theft prevention method based on on-off encryption verification, which belongs to the field of mobile intelligent terminals. Power-off verification information is set, the terminal can not be power-off if the verification is not passed, positioning information is checked in real time through a monitoring end, and the stolen mobile intelligent terminal is positioned, tracked and recovered; the mobile intelligent terminal sends the positioning information to the monitoring end, and the problem that no information of the stolen mobile intelligent terminal can be acquired when the owner does not use the monitoring end can be solved; a sending frequency is set, the mobile intelligent terminal regularly sends the positioning information and the real-time time to the monitoring end, the positioning information with the real-time time can be obtained continuously, and the possibility of finding more cell phone stolen clues is increased; and through human face recognition, photographing is only carried out when a human face is recognized, power loss caused by invalid photographing is avoided, the power-on time of the cell phone is prolonged, and after the human face picture is acquired, the stolen mobile intelligent terminal can be recovered through directing finding the person.

title: Intelligent bionic hand with rigid-flexible coupling joints based on nuclear environment and control method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent bionic hand of rigid-flexible coupling joints based on a nuclear environment and a control method. The mechanical arm comprises a rigid mechanical arm body and a flexible intelligent driving joint, the rigid mechanical arm body is connected with a mechanical arm controller, the flexible intelligent driving joint is fixed to the tail end of a finger joint of the rigid mechanical arm body, and the flexible intelligent driving joint comprises an inner-layer flexible driving material layer and an outer-layer flexible driving material layer; the inner-layer flexible driving material layer and the outer-layer flexible driving material layer are of U-shaped structures, a thin film sensor is embedded in the tail end of the side, making contact with an object, of the inner-layer flexible driving material layer, the thin film sensor is electrically connected with a flexible driving control power source and a sensing signal collector, and the thin film sensor is controlled through the sensing signal collector and obtains pressure data. Under the extreme condition of the nuclear environment, through the rigid-flexible coupling joints, the intelligent bionic mechanical arm has the sensing performance while being high in driving freedom degree and good in environmental adaptability, and set work such as detection, grabbing and moving can be independently sensed by the intelligent bionic mechanical arm.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom driving arm and double-arm robot adopting arm
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom driving arm and a double-arm robot adopting the arm. The multi-degree-of-freedom driving arm comprises single-degree-of-freedom driving modules and a plurality of double-degree-of-freedom driving modules; the single-degree-of-freedom driving modules are connected with the double-degree-of-freedom driving modules located on the innermost sides; the double-degree-of-freedom driving modules each have two orthogonal rotational degrees of freedom; the first rotational degrees of freedom comprise first driving mechanisms used for driving the driving modules to rotate; the second rotational degrees of freedom comprise second driving mechanisms used for driving the driving modules to rotate; and the first driving mechanisms of the double-degree-of-freedom driving modules located on the outer sides are arranged on the adjacent second driving mechanisms of the double-degree-of-freedom driving modules located on the inner sides. The single arm of the robot has seven degrees of freedom, the flexible and changeable effects are achieved, and the robot is suitable for accomplishing all kinds of complicated tasks; cost is low, the structure is compact, and the energy density of the structure of the multi-degree-of-freedom driving arm is maximized in the unit volume; and the arm adopts a modular structure, good interchangeability can be guaranteed, and maintenance cost is saved.

title: APPARATUS FOR CONTROLLING A HANDLING DEVICE
abstract: In an apparatus (1) for controlling a handling device comprising a carrier housing (2), which can be arranged on the handing device and has a tactile sensor body (4) which is arranged on the outside of the carrier housing (2), and comprising a tool carrier (3) mounted to move on the carrier housing (2), wherein the sensor body (4) can be actuated by the tool carrier (3) when the tool carrier (3) is subjected to load, the sensor body (4) is formed from a gas-filled chamber, which is surrounded by a flexible covering which can be deformed as a result of a collision with an obstacle, and further comprises a pressure sensor for measuring the gas pressure inside the chamber.

title: Truck scale voice system and upgrading method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an upgrading and reconstruction method and a system for a truck scale voice system. The method comprises six parts: upgrading an equipment power supply system, triggering thecondition upgrading, upgrading the information classification, upgrading and optimizing the network resource, testing and putting into use. The system comprises a UPS uninterruptible power supply, a remote PC, a remote switch, a local switch, a local industrial personal computer, a talkback headset, a network hard disk video recorder, an embedded microphone, a talkback trigger button, a power amplifier, a rainproof sound post and a metering software audio control system. The equipment is good in operation, and the failure rate of equipment is obviously reduced. The data transmission is more stable and the tone quality is clearer and smoother. The system cannot be disturbed by external electromagnetic equipment. The unmanned metering efficiency of the truck scale can be greatly improved.

title: Steering knuckle flash full-automatic grinding method and system based on 3D vision
abstract: The invention discloses a full-automatic grinding method and system for steering knuckle flash based on 3D vision, and relates to the technical field of casting post-processing automation. A trimming-free direct polishing process is innovatively provided, a casting is scanned in real time through a high-precision 3D visual system, a flash space molded line is accurately captured, and one-key calibration of a camera, automatic generation and dynamic simulation of a flash path, multi-tool intelligent switching and self-adaptive adjustment of residual height are achieved in combination with self-developed off-line programming software. According to the system, a robot is adopted for grabbing workpieces to cooperate with a fixed type multi-cutter work station, a disordered feeding technology is integrated for 2D/3D visual guiding grabbing, workpiece deformation and die difference are effectively dealt with, and flash residues are thoroughly eliminated. The method is characterized in that visual scanning, path planning and execution control are seamlessly fused, the dependence of traditional automatic grinding on the trimming process is broken through, the yield and efficiency are remarkably improved, and the industrial problem of full-process automation of casting flash is solved.

title: Robot system
abstract: A plurality of robots and pendants including enabling devices configured to enable or disable the working of the robots are provided. Robot controllers configured to control the driving of the robots are connected to one another via a communication line. An enable link signal according to the operating modes of the individual robots and the manipulation of one of the enabling devices is transmitted between the robot controllers, thereby performing on-off control of drive power to one of the robots corresponding to the corresponding one of the pendants.

title: Patrol robot for booster station of power plant based on 5G communication
abstract: The invention discloses a 5G communication-based inspection robot for a booster station of a power plant, which comprises a bottom plate and a mobile control panel, a first controller unit is arranged between a shell and a base, a first wireless communication module is arranged at the top of the shell, and ultrasonic obstacle avoidance sensors are mounted around the bottom plate; the side of the bottom plate is sequentially provided with infrared tracking sensors, and the top end of the mobile control panel is provided with a second wireless communication module and an Internet of Things communication module. According to the inspection robot for the booster station of the power plant based on 5G communication, the robot adopts the infrared tracking sensor, the ultrasonic obstacle avoidance sensor and the visual module to conduct route tracking and anti-collision protection, and the precision of the motion trail of the robot is improved. An environment data report and an environment comprehensive index are formed through the sensor module, and the combination of unified monitoring of the control center and real-time monitoring of the Internet of Things cloud platform is realized through the Lora wireless communication module and the Internet of Things communication module.

abstract: Embodiments of the invention disclose a processing method and a processing device for augmented reality, and a mobile terminal. title: Quadruped robot obstacle avoidance path planning method and system based on ESDF-Free
abstract: The invention provides a quadruped robot obstacle avoidance path planning method and system based on ESDF-Free, and the method comprises the steps: 1, generating a collision-free path without considering an obstacle based on a control point and a B spline curve, judging whether the control point on each path is affected by a collision object, if not, directly entering a step 3, and otherwise, executing a step 2; step 2, adding obstacle information and a distance field, generating a collision-free path by adopting an A * algorithm, and optimizing the collision-free path based on a gradient; and 3, judging whether the collision-free path is feasible or not, if the collision-free path is feasible, taking the path as a final planned path, and if the collision-free path is not feasible, optimizing the collision path obtained in the step 2 based on the time span path. According to the method, collision force estimation is avoided, the complexity of a quadruped robot system is reduced by simplifying data requirements, and calculation and storage burdens are reduced.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING A RESPONSE TO A USER QUERY USING A VISUAL ASSISTANT
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to providing at least one response to a user of a user device [210] using a visual assistant, wherein the at least one response is based on at least one user query. In an embodiment, the virtual assistant system [220] receives the at least one user query through a virtual multimedia contact, wherein the virtual multimedia contact is invoked by receiving a user command from the user through an interface [214, 216]. Thereafter, the virtual assistant system [220] determines the at least one response based on the at least one user query. Further, the virtual assistant system [220] selects a visual assistant (virtual character) for representing the at least one response and subsequently provides the at least one response to the user device [210] using the visual assistant by transmitting the at least one response to the user device [210] using the visual assistant.

title: Personalized course recommendation method and system based on multi-modal data analysis
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of education data mining methods, and provides a personalized course recommendation method and system based on multi-modal data analysis, and the technical scheme is as follows: obtaining learning data of students in different courses and multi-modal data of different courses; extracting multi-modal features of the students based on the learning data of the students; extracting corresponding modal features from the multi-modal data of each course, mapping different modal features to the same space to obtain the mapped modal features of each course, and splicing the mapped features to obtain the multi-modal representation of each course; and in combination with the multi-modal representation of the student, the multi-modal representation of each course and the trained course recommendation model, calculating to obtain a matching degree score of the course and the student, and recommending a corresponding course to the student according to the matching degree score. And the accuracy of course prediction is improved.

title: GRIPPER ATTACHMENT FOR ROBOT
abstract: A robot gripper attachment for use with conventional robotic platforms, the gripper having opposed claw members, each claw member in turn having a plurality of elongate projections. An inward facing surface of each projection is chamfered, defining an interior gripping surface. This gripping surface may be further provided with a friction material for increased grip. One or more cameras and sensors may be utilized to aid operation by providing the operator with information about depth, distance, and positioning.

abstract: Provided is a delta robot with a link arm spacing unit. title: Deep reinforcement learning method for transmission, transformation and distribution inspection fixed nest site selection
abstract: The invention provides a deep reinforcement learning method for transmission, transformation and distribution inspection fixed nest site selection, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle power inspection. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a naive Bayesian classification model, predicting risk probabilities of different towers according to attributes of the towers, historical abnormal conditions and nearby natural environments, and measuring importance degrees of the different towers; according to the historical operation data of the plurality of towers in the predetermined area, acquiring daily inspection frequencies of different towers; performing graph embedding on the transmission, transformation and distribution facilities to be inspected by using a graph attention network; establishing a deep reinforcement learning model based on a Markov process and training the deep reinforcement learning model to obtain strategy parameters; and selecting data information of a target position in a real data set to be inspected, and inputting the data information into the deep reinforcement learning model to complete a site selection task of the fixed nest. The method aims to determine a nest site selection scheme, and the optimal site selection of the nest is realized through accurate risk assessment and algorithm support.

title: AIGC text credibility dynamic evaluation system and method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to an AIGC text credibility dynamic evaluation system and method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence text evaluation. In order to solve the problems that a traditional method is poor in adaptability and generalization ability and cannot dynamically evaluate AIGC text credibility, a solution driven by reinforcement learning is provided, a Markov decision process is constructed through a deep Q network, and a credibility scoring strategy is dynamically adjusted; fusing the multi-dimensional features of the text, the context scene information and the real-time feedback of the user; a balance mechanism is designed, explored and utilized to accelerate algorithm convergence. The method has the technical effects that the dynamic adaptive capacity to novel false contents is remarkably improved; the objectivity and comprehensiveness of an evaluation result are enhanced; the large-scale text processing efficiency is optimized; and the generalization ability of a cross-domain application scene is expanded.

title: Object optimal grabbing identification method based on local point cloud model
abstract: The invention discloses an object optimal grabbing identification method based on a local point cloud model. The method comprises the steps that the local point cloud model of a measured object is acquired through a linear laser displacement sensor, then the contour of the point cloud model is extracted, a grabbing cuboid is generated based on a gravity center point, the score of the grabbing cuboid is quantified and calculated on the basis of a grabbing evaluation rule, and finally, an optimal grabbing mode is determined. Through the method, the optimal grabbing mode of an object can be automatically judged so that grabbing operation can be carried out through operation tools such as a mechanical arm, the method meets the requirements for accuracy, real-time performance and universality, and research results can be applied to the fields of industrial logistics sorting, carrying and the like.

title: COMBINED ROBOT
abstract: A combined robot, comprising an autonomous mobile robot (100) and a function module (200). The function module (200) is detachably combined to the autonomous mobile robot by using a connecting piece (300). Driving wheels (110) and a driven wheel (111) are disposed at the bottom of a body of the autonomous mobile robot. Using the forward direction (A) of the autonomous mobile robot during work as the front, the driving wheels are located at the left and right sides of the bottom of the body, and the driven wheel is located at the front or back of the bottom of the body. A control center is disposed in the combined robot to control the combined robot to work. The end at the bottom of the body of autonomous mobile robot away from the driven wheel is a support end. Floating support mechanisms (120) are disposed at the support end and can perform telescopic support, so that the body can keep parallel to a moving plane when the autonomous mobile robot moves, thereby improving the moving stability of the combined robot.

title: Interactive role-playing posable toy
abstract: In accordance with the present invention, there is provided an interactive posable toy that when positioned in various configurations, emits electronic sounds and/or produces motions indicative of such configurations. The posable toy includes a head pivotally attached to an upper torso. The upper torso is also pivotally attached to a mid-section, which is further pivotally attached to a lower torso. The arms and legs of the posable toy are pivotally and/or rotatably attached to the upper torso and lower torso, via shoulder and hip joints, respectively. The posable toy also includes a motor coupled a pair of cams. When activated, one of the cams laterally rocks the upper torso while the other cam tilts the mid-section relative to the lower torso. Positioned within each joint are means for triggering responses to specific positions of the arms and legs. A PC board is coupled to the triggering means as well as a power source, the motor and a speaker unit. The PC board upon receiving responses from the triggering means controls the motor to produce movement through the cams to the upper torso and mid-section. Moreover, the PC board also produces sounds through the speaker unit indicative of the specific positions of the posable toy.

title: Health monitoring robot having family affection interaction function and health monitoring method
abstract: The invention discloses a health monitoring robot having a family affection interaction function and a health monitoring method. title: Human body arm active anti-collision device for collaborative operation of human and collaborative robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of collaborative robots, and particularly discloses a human body arm active anti-collision device used during collaborative operation of a person and a collaborative robot, and the human body arm active anti-collision device comprises a wearable assembly, a control assembly, a driving assembly and a detection system. The wearable assembly is fixed to the trunk of the human body through the vest and extends to the arms. A central control panel of the control assembly is connected with a plurality of driving pulleys; the driving assembly is composed of a pulley ring, a pull wire and a wiring groove, and the movement direction of the arm is adjusted through tensioning of the pull wire. The detection system monitors the position and the distance between the human arm and the collaborative robot in real time through the image acquisition module, the image processing recognition module and the distance measurement positioning module. When it is detected that the distance is smaller than a safety threshold value, the control assembly drives the stepping motor to control the arm to actively avoid through the pull wire, and active collision prevention is achieved. Through active intervention, omnibearing monitoring and accurate judgment, the man-machine cooperation safety is effectively improved, meanwhile, the operation efficiency and the operation flexibility are considered, and the system is suitable for various industrial scenes.

title: System for automatically judging voice error wake-up and judging method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent speech testing, and specifically relates to a system for automatically judging voice error wake-up and a judging method thereof. The system comprisesa PC and a loudspeaker. A voltage comparator is connected to the PC serial port. The voltage comparator is respectively connected to an intelligent voice device to be tested through an acoustic sensorand a photosensitive sensor. The loudspeaker and the intelligent voice device to be tested are placed in the same test environment. The invention records the time point on the PC when the values of the sound sensor and the photosensitive sensor collected by the voltage comparator change during the playing process of the inverse phase set. Then the sound sensor compiles the sound information intothe computer and the recognized digital information through the analog-to-digital converter, and converts the sound information into the sound which can be read and displayed by the PC through the digital-to-analog converter, and grasps the speech before and after the wrong wake-up period, so that the wrong wake-up situation can be conveniently and quickly tested, and the judgment and recording can be carried out.

title: Operation safety early warning method and system suitable for intelligent power plant
abstract: The invention provides an operation safety early warning method and system suitable for an intelligent power plant, and relates to the technical field of electric digital data processing.The method comprises the steps that historical faults are classified and integrated and divided according to the thermal power generation production process, and divided and classified integrated data are obtained; determining fault correlation parameters and a correlation ratio according to the divided and classified integrated data, generating a fault correlation interval according to the fault time node, determining an influence correlation parameter set according to the divided and classified integrated data and the fault correlation interval, and determining an influence weight of each influence correlation parameter; and constructing a multi-level data model according to the fault correlation parameters and the influence correlation parameter set, and inputting the monitoring data into the multi-level data model to obtain an operation safety early warning result. The technical problems that in the prior art, power plant fault early warning depends on artificial experience, consequently, faults are found late, and many faults are remedied afterwards are solved. The technical effects of power plant fault beforehand prevention and early accident discovery, prevention and treatment are achieved.

title: Tumble detection method based on improved key frame extraction
abstract: The invention provides a tumble detection method based on improved key frame extraction. The tumble detection method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring an unprocessed original video stream; S2, performing key frame extraction on the original video stream preliminarily by using an inter-frame difference method; S3, performing secondary optimization on the key frame generated in the step S2 by using a clustering algorithm to obtain an optimal key frame; S4, extracting features from the optimal key frame, and constructing a feature vector; S5, serving the extracted feature vectors as input of a support vector machine SVM, and performing initial judgment, wherein the support vector machine is used for distinguishing a non-tumble behavior, a tumble behavior and a tumble-like behavior; and S6, carrying out secondary classification on the feature vectors of which the distinguishing results are the tumble-like behaviors by utilizing a convolutional neural network, outputting a detection result, and finishing final detection of the tumble behaviors. Compared with a traditional clustering method, the algorithm provided by the invention not only has lower redundancy, but also has higher recall ratio and accuracy, and can save a lot of time and improve the accuracy for subsequent detection of the fall behavior.

title: Mechanical arm motion control method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention relates to a mechanical arm motion control method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps that 1, the space interpolation amount of at least two controllers of a mechanical arm on the target freedom degree is obtained, wherein the space interpolation amount is the Cartesian space interpolation amount or the joint space interpolation amount; 2, a fusion interpolation amount is determined according to the spatial interpolation amount and a preset model; 3, a target pose is determined based on the fusion interpolation amount and the current pose of the mechanical arm on the target degree of freedom; and 4, the mechanical arm is controlled to move on the target freedom degree according to the target pose. According to the method, the motion data setting of the mechanical arm can be simplified, and the coping capacity of the mechanical arm facing complex working scenes is improved.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING A MULTI-LEGGED ROBOT
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a system and a method for controlling a robot to perform a task. The robot is a legged robot that comprises a trunk and a plurality of legs for supporting the trunk above a ground. The system is configured to collect a reference trajectory defining a sequence of states of the robot to perform the task and execute a stance controller configured to compute and apply reaction force s of the plurality of legs of the robot in contact with the ground to push the trunk based on the reference trajectory. The system is further configured to execute a swing controller of a plurality of swing controllers to swing a leg in response to detecting a relative position between the trunk and a foot of the leg of the robot indicative of an imbalance of a support of the trunk of the robot above the ground.

title: Task allocation method of intelligent terminal based on AI edge decision and related device
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent terminal task allocation method based on AI edge decision and a related device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining environment data and task attribute data in a target power operation region, obtaining target environment data and m pieces of task attribute data, transmitting the target environment data to n intelligent terminals, calculating according to the target environment data through n intelligent terminals to obtain n pieces of first calculation performance data, returning the n pieces of first calculation performance data to the electronic equipment, and determining a first adaptation degree matrix of tasks and intelligent terminal performance according to the n pieces of first calculation performance data and the m pieces of task attribute data, determining a target task allocation strategy according to a preset constraint condition and the first adaptation degree matrix; and controlling the n intelligent terminals to execute the edge decision according to the target task allocation strategy. In an electric power operation scene, the accuracy and robustness of task allocation for distributed terminal decision making can be improved.
